_comment: This file is only for the console entry point (npm run serve / npm run review). The desktop app does NOT read it - it keeps its settings in %APPDATA%\bw-ladder-review-overlay\settings.json, edited in the window. Copy this to config.json in the folder you run node from.
_starcraftInstallPath: Autodetected from the registry, then from the usual install folders. Set it only if the autodetect gets it wrong.
_lastReplayPath: Autodetected under Documents\StarCraft\Maps\Replays. Set it if your replays live elsewhere.
